items.label: Vintage Gooseneck RLM
items.value: This Satin Black barn light has a 14 inch shade diameter with 14-1/2 inch long gooseneck arm, and extends out a total 21.59 inches from the mounting plate to the end of the shade

items.label: Applications
items.value: Ideal for Sign Lighting, Barn Lighting, Awnings, Storefronts, Awnings, Wall Lighting, among many other great applications

items.label: Easy Install
items.value: Hardware Kit is included and comes with a 4.70 inch mounting plate and mounting bracket to fit over just about any weatherproof electrical box

items.label: Commercial Outdoor Rated
items.value: Painted using durable powder coating to enable superior protection, even in the toughest environments

items.label: Safety Rated & Reliable
items.value: UL Listed for Wet Location & compatible with any LED Bulbs, Incandescent Bulb, and CFLs with E26 Medium Base

items.label: Other Special Features of the Product
items.value: Manufactured using durable cold rolled steel material and die cast zinc with while liners for increased reflectivity
